title: Rules Action & Roll Bridge
objective: Implement a bounded provider-neutral rules-action and roll bridge contract that routes derivative external VTT requests through Multiversal validation/resolution and returns authoritative receipts/results for external presentation while Multiversal remains canonical authority.

authorized: provider-neutral action-request envelopes for rolls, attacks, checks, powers, resources, conditions, initiative, reactions and GM adjudication
deterministic Multiversal validation/resolution handoff semantics that keep external VTTs as requesting clients rather than rules authorities
authoritative result and receipt envelopes preserving canonical source references, visibility, ownership, consent and GM-authority metadata
deterministic external-presentation envelopes that expose only explicitly present result fields and preserve redacted or unsupported fidelity without manufacturing hidden information
duplicate/idempotent request handling, authoritative receipt replay and status-before-retry semantics compatible with the completed VTI-03 and MIB-03 recovery contracts
acceptance fixtures, deterministic normalization, invariant validation and receipts needed to prove the bounded bridge contract
not_authorized: provider-specific schemas, vendor selection/ranking or VTI-09 platform commitment
re-authoring or bypassing native Multiversal rules resolution, external-VTT rules authority, external-VTT RNG authority or autonomous GM adjudication
credentials, external account mutation, adapter implementation, live external synchronization mutation or canonical game-state mutation
durable VTI persistence or a new migration before separately authorized persistence work
VTI-05 character-sheet/item/compendium projection, VTI-06 scene/map/token/MAI behavior or any VTI-05+ implementation
provider activation, tester distribution, package distribution, release, deployment or SGC-01+ implementation

governed_start_boundaries: VTI-03 remains completed_verified and frozen with its implementation authority retired.
Multiversal remains canonical rules/campaign authority; external VTTs may request actions and present authoritative results but may not resolve canonical rules independently.
VTI-04 bounded production-contract authority is unlocked only after genuine matching acceptance RED; live provider/external/canonical mutation remains unauthorized.
The acceptance contract may cover roll, attack, check, power, resource, condition, initiative, reaction and GM-adjudication request/result semantics without implementing provider-specific adapters.
Visibility, ownership, consent, hidden-information filtering and GM authority remain mandatory preserved constraints across request, resolution and presentation metadata.
VTI-03 idempotency/recovery semantics remain reusable; duplicate external requests must replay authoritative receipts or status-check before retry rather than resolve twice.
Platform selection remains evidence-driven and deferred to VTI-09; no vendor is selected or ranked.
VTI-05+, durable persistence/new migration, credentials/external accounts/adapters, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.

convergence_control.last_failure_signature: stale VTI-04 RED-unlock regressions pinned production and bridge authority false after matching RED
convergence_control.retry_basis: changed control-plane assertions to follow RED-gated VTI-04 production authority while keeping external rules/RNG/GM/provider/mutation authority closed

next_action: Validate and merge the changed-evidence VTI-04 RED-unlock AIOC head, then implement only packages/contracts/src/virtual-tabletop-interoperability/rules-action-roll-bridge-contract.ts on the existing application branch and prove exact-head repository health, Linux GREEN, Windows GREEN and deterministic comparison before merge.
